_about: Hand-entered from Ofgem, Transmission Annual Report for 2008-09 (Ref 48/10), Table 22 - NGET Revenue Summary, PDF p.38: the two balancing-cost rows the BSUoS-basis gross-up factor is computed from (ticket 48; EIC ruling 17 Oct 2026 18:50, after pass 5; file ruled .json, Richard 18 Oct 2026). Each row quotes the stored PDF (whitespace collapsed); tests/test_balancing.py hashes data/raw/ofgem_s18b/transmission_annual_report_final.pdf against each row's sha256 and checks every quote against page 38's text (pdftotext -layout -f 38 -l 38), and the factor against balancing.tar_balancing(). Not figures keys, not sourced keys: reference rows that let the fact-checker trace the factor.
